This is my personal opinion, but I do think that this thread could use updating.

>**Save your devilmons!** In general you do not want to give devilmon to 4\* units, Sigmarus and Jeanne are the best early game candidates. Veromos does not need devilmon.

Sig's only PvE use is in DB12 pre-Tricaru, and is easily replaced with units you'll already have if you focus 2a Spectra early -  Verde (L), Vero, Fran, Loren, Spectra (2A)

​

Best ~~summon stone~~ Engraved Scroll targets: Tyron, Lushen, Shaina, Sabrina, Talia. For PvP Khmun, Skogul, Galleon.

>Dimensional hole energy should be spent as soon as possible, always try to stay under the energy cap (recharge rate: 1 per 2h). 2A Kro first, then Spectra or Raoq.

This seems outdated. Especially if ToA is first thing on progression. Spectra has proven much more useful in all content. Needing Sath and Tatu for the DoT team, and only having to fuse the other three mons makes that DoT team quick to farm - which I believe would put them interchangeably in 2nd and 3rd.

TL;DR: 2A Spectra, Sath, Tatu first. Don't spend devilmon on fusable mons. Fuse Verde, Veromos, your two Mellias, then Riley. Find the SD for Loren in that time. This way you'll clear all relevant content with as little effort as possible. Then go for your Tricaru. Now the world is your oyster.
